CITY OF LA VERNE
  DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE
  ACTION MINUTES

Eric Scherer, Chair  City Hall
Cody Howing, City Engineer  3660 “D” Street
Danny Wu, Public Works  La Verne, CA 91750
  (909) 596-8706
  www.cityoflaverne.org

  Tuesday, April 1, 2025 – 9:00 a.m.
  City Hall Council Chambers
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Development Review Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Development Review Committee
with valuable information. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st Tuesday of every month. In
compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s
Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The Council Chambers will be open to the public at 9:00 a.m. Materials related to an item on this
agenda, submitted to the Development Review Committee after distribution of the agenda packet,
are available for public inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during
normal business hours.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  Mr. Scherer called the meeting to order at 9:00 a.m.

  Voting members present: Eric Scherer, Cody Howing, and Danny Wu

  Others present: Assistant Planner Valerie Chin, Associate Planner Parker
  Stringfellow and Fire Marshal Fred St. Ange
 Development Review Committee Action Minutes - April 1, 2025
Page 2

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Development Review
  Committee on items not listed in any other place on this agenda.

  California Law does not allow the Development Review Committee to take action in
  response to your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to
  staff or set for hearing at a later date.

  3. APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES – March 4, 2025

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Wu to approve the minutes of
  the March 4, 2025 meeting. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  4. PROJECT REVIEWS
  Note: Due to time constraints, discussion on these items will be limited to 30
  minutes each.

  A.  PROJECT:  A REQUEST TO MERGE TWO PARCELS
  CASE NO:  10-25PM
  ADDRESS:  2046 WALNUT STREET
  Project Planner:  Parker Stringfellow

  Deposit Project #: 1452
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: Johnnie Rightmer of Rightmer Home Improvement and Jimmy Ho
  were present.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Wu to approve Case No.
  10-25PM. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  B.  PROJECT:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW THE
  OPERATION OF AN INDOOR PRIVATE TRAINING
  FACILITY (THE FORGE)
  CASE NO:  26-25CUP
  ADDRESS:  968 PALOMARES AVENUE
  Project Planner:  Valerie Chin

  Deposit Project #: 1454
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: Loddy Chao of Techfwd LLC, Sonny Soohoo, Danna Zhu, Emily
  Sun, and Sean Yang of Plouto Plus, Inc. was present at the meeting.

  2
 Development Review Committee Action Minutes - April 1, 2025
Page 3
  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Wu to recommend
  approval of Case No. 26-25CUP. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  C.  PROJECT:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW THE
  OPERATIONS OF TRADER JOE’S GROCERY STORE
  AND OFF-SITE ALCOHOL SALES
  CASE NO:  28-25CUP AND 29-25CUP
  ADDRESS:  2330 FOOTHILL BLVD
  Project Planner:  Valerie Chin

  Deposit Project #: 1453
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: Alton Klein, Melissa Miller and Kristin Basalone-Ortega of Trader
  Joe’s were present at the meeting.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Wu to recommend
  approval of Case No. 28-25CUP with a modification to Condition #11
  changing the direction from “south” to “north”. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  5. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:38 p.m. The next meeting of the Development
  Review Committee is scheduled to be held on May 6, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. at City Hall,
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Natalie Hiatt, Administrative Secretary
